description: Text to speech and speech to text for all of VS Code: a player in every text editor (reads the text or the clipboard aloud, dictates at the cursor), system and Piper voices, Whisper recognition (sherpa-onnx), settings in the side bar and an API for other extensions; a formatted view of JSON files
config.tts.enabled: Text to speech: reading text editors aloud and the speech asked for by other extensions.
config.tts.volume: Volume of the speech, in % of the volume set on the computer.
config.tts.rate: Speed of the speech (1 is the normal speed).
config.tts.activeDrivers: Drivers that speak together: `system` and drivers added to `#ttsSttAloud.tts.drivers#`; their voices are offered together, each phrase is spoken by the driver of its voice.
config.tts.servers: External TTS servers (their keys are kept in the secret storage of VS Code).
config.tts.voice: The voice chosen in the side bar (the voice test).
config.tts.voices: Checked voices by driver: picked automatically for reading aloud and offered to other extensions.
config.tts.models: Files of the voice models by driver (Piper, Silero: .onnx files prepared for sherpa-onnx, with tokens.txt next to them), chosen on the disk or downloaded in the side bar.
config.stt.enabled: Speech to text: lets other extensions record the microphone. The microphone test of the side bar works either way.
config.stt.volume: Gain of the microphone signal, in % (100 is the signal as recorded).
config.stt.driver: Driver of speech recognition, one of `#ttsSttAloud.stt.drivers#`; empty or not offered: the first of them.
config.stt.drivers: Drivers of speech recognition offered: `whisper`, `external:<server name>`.
config.stt.servers: External STT servers (their keys are kept in the secret storage of VS Code).
config.stt.models: Files of the models by driver (Whisper: the encoder of a model of sherpa-onnx, its decoder and tokens next to it), chosen on the disk or downloaded in the side bar.
config.stt.model: The model that recognizes speech (the path of a Whisper encoder of ttsSttAloud.stt.models; empty: the first ready one).
config.stt.language: Language of recognition: empty — Whisper detects it; "ui" — the language of VS Code; else a language code (ru, uk, en, …).
